# Junaid Irfan

> Software & Game Developer, 3D Modeler & Animator, and Modder / Reverse Engineer. CS student working with C#, C++, Python, and Unity — building everything from backend APIs and native desktop applications to full 3D games with self-made assets. Available for freelance contracts and commissions on Upwork.

Site: https://junaidirf.github.io/ — Main portfolio covering projects, links, and contact.
Upwork Portfolio: https://junaidirf.github.io/upwork.html — Upwork-compliant version without direct off-platform contact info.
Handle: JunaidIRF.
Location: Pakistan (UTC+5).

## Services & Core Skills

- **Game Development (Unity, C#)**: Full-cycle game development, combat and movement mechanics, procedural generation, roguelike systems, performance optimization, and custom shaders.
- **3D Modeling & Animation (Blender)**: Self-made low-poly and stylized 3D assets, character modeling, texturing, rigging, weapon models, and fluid animation cycles.
- **Desktop Software & Tools (C++, C#, Python)**: Native Windows desktop applications, GUI utilities (WinForms/WPF), multi-threaded systems, automation scripts, and custom launchers.
- **Reverse Engineering & Modding**: Game modding via BepInEx (C#), binary disassembly and analysis, packet inspection, and custom hardware driver reverse engineering.
- **Networking & Sockets**: Socket programming, P2P network tunneling, virtual LAN emulation, and real-time IPC bridges (e.g., Discord bot to Unity engine).

## Released

- [ExecuDunk](https://junaidirf.itch.io/execudunk): Endless action roguelike built in Unity. Grab, execute, and dunk enemies into hoops; difficulty scales each in-game day while spending coins on dunk upgrades, weapons, and items. Features parry mechanics, boss quests, bullet deflection, and gambling minigames.

## Projects

- [TABG DirectConnect](https://github.com/JunaidIRF/TABG-DirectConnect-Plugin): BepInEx plugin (C#) for Totally Accurate Battlegrounds adding direct IP:Port connections, allowing players to connect to custom lobbies without matchmaking. Pinned in Landfall's official TABG Discord server in `#tabg-community-servers`.
- [Die to Possess](https://x.com/JunaidIRF_/status/2087893710461649375): Work-in-progress Unity action game where you possess the enemy that eliminates you; possession chance increases per kill with scaling bonuses based on max health differences.
- [Unity x Discord Bridge](https://youtu.be/jOIG_oBZPb4): Real-time IPC bridge connecting a Discord bot to Unity over localhost, piping messages and images across as base64 to render directly inside the game engine.
- [PlayLAN](https://github.com/JunaidIRF/PlayLAN): Virtual LAN tunneling software (C++) for playing LAN games over the internet with low latency, featuring an adapter setup and a game hub fed by a public JSON repository.
- TABG Map Editor: Unity-based map editor for TABG featuring a 4800+ item object browser, live collider/rigidbody inspection, and full scene import/export.
- [UIPorter](https://github.com/JunaidIRF/UIPorter): Java cross-framework tool converting UI definitions between frameworks into their native target languages, featuring an AI-assisted translation mode.
- [WordGuesser](https://github.com/JunaidIRF/WordGuesser): C++/WinForms pattern-based word puzzle game with user accounts and leaderboards. Awarded 1st place at a university project exhibition.
- [FreeSiegeLauncher](https://github.com/JunaidIRF/FreeSiegeLauncher): C# desktop launcher built on a custom DepotDownloader fork for downloading and launching legacy Rainbow Six Siege builds.
- [EASE EGM-110 Driver](https://github.com/JunaidIRF/EASE-EGM-110-Gaming-Mouse-Driver): Reverse-engineered peripheral driver for the 825F sensor chip, unlocking 1000 Hz polling rate, macro keys, onboard DPI profiles, and RGB lighting control.
